say:1:1841112001:1.text: You know what kind of place Ashvale County is.
say:1:1841112001:1.source_cn: 你应当知道灰影郡是什么地方。
say:1:1841112001:1.male: You know what kind of place Ashvale County is.
say:1:1841112001:1.female: You know what kind of place Ashvale County is.

say:2:1841112002:1.text: It sits on the Lightbearer frontier, on land once held by Bantus—a battlefield steeped in blood. House Rayne has never had an easy time ruling here.
say:2:1841112002:1.source_cn: 耀光帝国的边境，班题斯的旧土，血腥的战场。瑞恩家族在这...
say:2:1841112002:1.male: It sits on the Lightbearer frontier, on land once held by Bantus—a battlefield steeped in blood. House Rayne has never had an easy time ruling here.
say:2:1841112002:1.female: It sits on the Lightbearer frontier, on land once held by Bantus—a battlefield steeped in blood. House Rayne has never had an easy time ruling here.

say:3:1841112003:1.text: In fact, House Rayne has never been a family of rulers so much as a family of frontier commanders. They lead their people in the fight against every invasion.
say:3:1841112003:1.source_cn: 比起统治者，瑞恩家族更像是驻守边境的将军，带领子民反抗...
say:3:1841112003:1.male: In fact, House Rayne has never been a family of rulers so much as a family of frontier commanders. They lead their people in the fight against every invasion.
say:3:1841112003:1.female: In fact, House Rayne has never been a family of rulers so much as a family of frontier commanders. They lead their people in the fight against every invasion.

say:4:1841112004:1.text: Almost every head of the house has died in battle... Each heir begins military training as a child and joins the fighting as soon as they come of age.
say:4:1841112004:1.source_cn: 历任家主几乎都死于战场上……每个继承人都会从幼时开始接...
say:4:1841112004:1.male: Almost every head of the house has died in battle... Each heir begins military training as a child and joins the fighting as soon as they come of age.
say:4:1841112004:1.female: Almost every head of the house has died in battle... Each heir begins military training as a child and joins the fighting as soon as they come of age.

say:5:1841112005:1.text: Since Baden disappeared, House Rayne has been desperately short of heirs. Even Estrilda, the eldest among them, hasn't come of age yet.
say:5:1841112005:1.source_cn: 巴登失踪后，瑞恩家族的继承人已经寥寥无几，连其中年龄最...
say:5:1841112005:1.male: Since Baden disappeared, House Rayne has been desperately short of heirs. Even Estrilda, the eldest among them, hasn't come of age yet.
say:5:1841112005:1.female: Since Baden disappeared, House Rayne has been desperately short of heirs. Even Estrilda, the eldest among them, hasn't come of age yet.

say:6:1841112006:1.text: I left the army and became House Rayne's butler so I could protect them in Baden's place. I advise Estrilda... and help prepare the next generation of heirs.
say:6:1841112006:1.source_cn: 为了替巴登守护他们，我离开军队，以管家的身份进入了瑞恩...
say:6:1841112006:1.male: I left the army and became House Rayne's butler so I could protect them in Baden's place. I advise Estrilda... and help prepare the next generation of heirs.
say:6:1841112006:1.female: I left the army and became House Rayne's butler so I could protect them in Baden's place. I advise Estrilda... and help prepare the next generation of heirs.

choice_prompt:7:1841112006.text: I left the army and became House Rayne's butler so I could protect them in Baden's place. I advise Estrilda... and help prepare the next generation of heirs.
choice_prompt:7:1841112006.source_cn: 为了替巴登守护他们，我离开军队，以管家的身份进入了瑞恩家族。既辅佐爱丝……也帮他们培养更多继承人。
choice_prompt:7:1841112006.male: I left the army and became House Rayne's butler so I could protect them in Baden's place. I advise Estrilda... and help prepare the next generation of heirs.
choice_prompt:7:1841112006.female: I left the army and became House Rayne's butler so I could protect them in Baden's place. I advise Estrilda... and help prepare the next generation of heirs.

say:8:1841112009:1.text: The work itself wasn't the hardest part... It was living with the guilt of walking away from the battlefield.
say:8:1841112009:1.source_cn: 对我而言，最困难的不是管家的工作……而是离开战场的自责。
say:8:1841112009:1.male: The work itself wasn't the hardest part... It was living with the guilt of walking away from the battlefield.
say:8:1841112009:1.female: The work itself wasn't the hardest part... It was living with the guilt of walking away from the battlefield.

say:9:1841112010:1.text: If I'd been more careful in that battle—if I hadn't pushed so hard—Baden might never have disappeared, and Estrilda wouldn't have had to take charge of the house so young.
say:9:1841112010:1.source_cn: 如果当初那场战役中我能再小心一点，不要那么激进，或许巴...
say:9:1841112010:1.male: If I'd been more careful in that battle—if I hadn't pushed so hard—Baden might never have disappeared, and Estrilda wouldn't have had to take charge of the house so young.
say:9:1841112010:1.female: If I'd been more careful in that battle—if I hadn't pushed so hard—Baden might never have disappeared, and Estrilda wouldn't have had to take charge of the house so young.

say:10:1841112011:1.text: She's never complained, but I know she's had it even harder than I have.
say:10:1841112011:1.source_cn: 虽然她从没抱怨过，但我知道，她过得比我更加辛苦。
say:10:1841112011:1.male: She's never complained, but I know she's had it even harder than I have.
say:10:1841112011:1.female: She's never complained, but I know she's had it even harder than I have.

say:11:1841112012:1.text: She's stubborn. She puts on the brave face everyone expects from the head of the house and hides all her pain behind it. Baden was the same. No matter how badly he was hurt, he'd grit his teeth and never let anyone see.
say:11:1841112012:1.source_cn: 她很倔强，把所有痛苦都隐藏在家主的面具下。就像巴登，不...
say:11:1841112012:1.male: She's stubborn. She puts on the brave face everyone expects from the head of the house and hides all her pain behind it. Baden was the same. No matter how badly he was hurt, he'd grit his teeth and never let anyone see.
say:11:1841112012:1.female: She's stubborn. She puts on the brave face everyone expects from the head of the house and hides all her pain behind it. Baden was the same. No matter how badly he was hurt, he'd grit his teeth and never let anyone see.

say:12:1841112013:1.text: Sometimes I'm glad I took the butler's position. It lets me shield Estrilda from what pains her most.
say:12:1841112013:1.source_cn: 有时候我很庆幸自己当初接下了管家之职，这让我能帮爱丝处...
say:12:1841112013:1.male: Sometimes I'm glad I took the butler's position. It lets me shield Estrilda from what pains her most.
say:12:1841112013:1.female: Sometimes I'm glad I took the butler's position. It lets me shield Estrilda from what pains her most.

say:13:1841112014:1.text: All I want now is to make life a little easier for her and Baden.
say:13:1841112014:1.source_cn: 让她和巴登过得尽量好一些，是我现在最重要的目标。
say:13:1841112014:1.male: All I want now is to make life a little easier for her and Baden.
say:13:1841112014:1.female: All I want now is to make life a little easier for her and Baden.

choice_prompt:14:1841112014.text: All I want now is to make life a little easier for her and Baden.
choice_prompt:14:1841112014.source_cn: 让她和巴登过得尽量好一些，是我现在最重要的目标。
choice_prompt:14:1841112014.male: All I want now is to make life a little easier for her and Baden.
choice_prompt:14:1841112014.female: All I want now is to make life a little easier for her and Baden.

say:15:1841112015:1.text: House Rayne is no ordinary family. With war raging in Ashvale County, neither is the role of its butler.
say:15:1841112015:1.source_cn: 瑞恩家族很特殊，灰影郡的战事让这里变得更特殊。
say:15:1841112015:1.male: House Rayne is no ordinary family. With war raging in Ashvale County, neither is the role of its butler.
say:15:1841112015:1.female: House Rayne is no ordinary family. With war raging in Ashvale County, neither is the role of its butler.

say:16:1841112016:1.text: One day I'm riding out with the army and helping plan a campaign; the next I'm balancing the books, checking the stables, or managing the servants. It's all part of the job.
say:16:1841112016:1.source_cn: 大到随军作战，为战事出谋划策，小到管账、管马厩、管家中...
say:16:1841112016:1.male: One day I'm riding out with the army and helping plan a campaign; the next I'm balancing the books, checking the stables, or managing the servants. It's all part of the job.
say:16:1841112016:1.female: One day I'm riding out with the army and helping plan a campaign; the next I'm balancing the books, checking the stables, or managing the servants. It's all part of the job.

say:17:1841112017:1.text: I'll remain with House Rayne for as long as Estrilda needs me, doing what I can to ease the burden on her and Baden.
say:17:1841112017:1.source_cn: 在爱丝不需要我之前，我都会留在瑞恩家族，替她和巴登分忧。
say:17:1841112017:1.male: I'll remain with House Rayne for as long as Estrilda needs me, doing what I can to ease the burden on her and Baden.
say:17:1841112017:1.female: I'll remain with House Rayne for as long as Estrilda needs me, doing what I can to ease the burden on her and Baden.

choice:14:0:1.text: You do far more than an ordinary butler.
choice:14:0:1.source_cn: 你做的事比普通的管家多多了
choice:14:0:1.male: You do far more than an ordinary butler.
choice:14:0:1.female: You do far more than an ordinary butler.

say:19:1841112007:1.text: Estrilda is wise beyond her years, and already a capable head of the house.
say:19:1841112007:1.source_cn: 爱丝是一个懂事的孩子，也是一位称职的家主。
say:19:1841112007:1.male: Estrilda is wise beyond her years, and already a capable head of the house.
say:19:1841112007:1.female: Estrilda is wise beyond her years, and already a capable head of the house.

choice:7:1:2.text: No wonder Estrilda trusts you so much.
choice:7:1:2.male: No wonder Estrilda trusts you so much.
choice:7:1:2.female: No wonder Estrilda trusts you so much.

say:20:1841112008:1.text: ... I didn't do it for his gratitude.
say:20:1841112008:1.source_cn: ……我做这些并不是为了他的感谢。
say:20:1841112008:1.male: ... I didn't do it for his gratitude.
say:20:1841112008:1.female: ... I didn't do it for his gratitude.

choice:7:2:3.text: Baden will thank you once he gets his memories back.
choice:7:2:3.source_cn: 巴登恢复记忆后，一定会感谢你的
choice:7:2:3.male: Baden will thank you once he gets his memories back.
choice:7:2:3.female: Baden will thank you once he gets his memories back.
